'''Geejaws''' were [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavians]] native to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="WSW" />

Known for their wide variety of calls and mimicry, geejaws were inquisitive creatures. They had sharp beaks which they used to build nests, laying several [[Geejaw egg|eggs]] at a time, in which both parents would care for helpless chicks.<ref name="WSW" />

Common prey of the [[Temptor/Legends|temptors]] and other animals on Endor, geejaws had to build nests high above ground or in hard to reach places.
